news.title: Wall Street Models Lag Structural Reality, Prompting Me To Add an ‘Overvalued’ Apple
news.summary: Apple trades above every analyst target on the Street, yet one investor keeps buying after each earnings report. Why he passes on cheaper-looking Microsoft and Alphabet, and what memory costs could do to the thesis, makes for a contrarian case.
news.title_zh: 華爾街模型落後於結構性現實，促使我增持「高估」的蘋果
news.summary_zh: 蘋果股價高於華爾街所有分析師目標價，但一位投資人在每次財報後持續買入。為何他放棄看似更便宜的微軟和Alphabet，以及記憶體成本可能對投資論點造成的影響，構成了一個反向投資案例。

news.title: What to Watch When Berkshire Hathaway Files Its 13F on Monday
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway’s 13F for the quarter ended Sept. 30 is due Monday, and its last one showed Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola, Alphabet and Bank of America as its five biggest positions.
news.title_zh: 伯克希爾·哈撒韋週一提交 13F 時應關注什麼
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：伯克希爾·哈撒韋截至 Sept. 30 季度的 13F 將於週一公布，其上一份報告顯示蘋果、美國運通、可口可樂、Alphabet 和美國銀行為其前五大持倉。

news.title: Arm CEO: The World Is “Ready and Willing” to Build the Data Centers America Blocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysArm CEO Rene Haas warned that “the rest of the world is ready and willing” to build data centers if the US holds back, after local voters rejected 40 of 41 data center ballot measures by Scott Galloway’s count. Long-running AI agents don’t need to sit near their users, so the build-out can move abroad, and Alphabet’s Google just committed $15 billion to Malaysia, much of it for data center campuses.
news.title_zh: Arm執行長：世界已「準備好並願意」建設美國阻擋的數據中心
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Arm執行長Rene Haas警告稱，若美國阻撓，根據Scott Galloway的統計，當地選民否決了 40 項 41 數據中心投票提案，「世界其他地方已準備好並願意」建設數據中心。長期運行的AI代理不需靠近用戶，因此建設可移往海外，Alphabet旗下Google剛承諾投入 $15 billion 於馬來西亞，其中大部分用於數據中心園區。

news.title: Alphabet’s Misunderstood TPUs Are a Hidden Catalyst Investors Haven’t Yet Noticed
news.summary: Alphabet stock just tumbled, yet one investor keeps buying faster. A quiet business inside Google may be draining spending from the market's favorite chipmaker, and Wall Street still prices the company as if it doesn't exist. What is the market overlooking?
news.title_zh: Alphabet 被誤解的 TPU 是投資人尚未察覺的隱藏催化劑
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 股價剛暴跌，但有一位投資人卻加快買進步伐。Google 內部一項低調業務可能正在從市場最愛的晶片製造商手中吸走支出，而華爾街仍像該公司不存在一樣為其定價。市場忽略了什麼？

news.title: Reddit Sinks 6% as Traffic Falls 13% on Google’s AI Overviews: “Not Traffic Drivers”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysReddit shares fell 6% after Similarweb data showed a 13% drop in global visits, which Business Insider blamed on Google’s AI Overviews. Most of the lost visits were logged out, and the logged-in users behind over 80% of its monetization are still growing.
news.title_zh: Reddit 下跌 6% 隨著流量下滑 13% 因 Google AI 概覽：「非流量驅動因素」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Reddit 股價下跌 6%，Similarweb 數據顯示全球造訪量下降 13%，Business Insider 歸咎於 Google 的 AI 概覽。大部分流失造訪來自未登入用戶，而佔其營收超過 80% 的已登入用戶仍在增長。

news.title: Alphabet and Meta Platforms Pay Dividends. Is Either of Them Worth Owning for Income?
news.summary: Both of these internet heavyweights announced quarterly dividends in the first half of 2024.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 和 Meta Platforms 發放股息。它們其中任何一家值得為了收益而持有嗎？
news.summary_zh: 這兩大網路巨頭都在 2024 上半年宣佈了季度股息。

news.title: AMD Swung 17% Down and Back in One Week: Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares fell 17% on November 5, then recovered after Alphabet’s Google Cloud picked its EPYC chips and Oppenheimer upgraded the stock. Third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.
news.title_zh: AMD 一週內暴跌 17% 又反彈：獲利了結，還是加碼買進？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要AMD 股價在 November 5 下跌 17%，隨後因 Alphabet 的 Google Cloud 選用其 EPYC 晶片且 Oppenheimer 上調評級而反彈。第三季營收成長 45% 至 $13。

news.title: Meta Jumps 5% as JPMorgan Picks It Over Alphabet While $60 Billion in New Funding Lands
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSince late October, Meta has lined up more than $60 billion in stock, preferred and bonds, including $25 billion of Class A shares priced at $625. Third-quarter capex of $34.
news.title_zh: Meta 上漲 5% 因 JPMorgan 看好其勝過 Alphabet，同時 $60 Billion 新資金湧入
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要自十月底以來，Meta 已籌集超過 $60 billion 的股票、優先股和債券，包括以 $625 定價的 $25 billion A 類股。第三季資本支出為 $34。

news.title: Cathie Wood Bought Cerebras Before It Fell 54%. Is She Wrong, or Early?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCerebras is down 54% since June 30, when Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest held 764,613 shares as a new position. SpaceX, Alphabet, Kratos and NVIDIA, ARK’s other second-quarter buys, are down 13% to 26% over the same stretch.
news.title_zh: Cathie Wood 在 Cerebras 下跌 54% 前買入。她是錯了，還是太早？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Cerebras 自 June 30 以來下跌 54%，當時 Cathie Wood 的 ARK Invest 持有 764,613 股作為新部位。SpaceX、Alphabet、Kratos 和 NVIDIA 等 ARK 第二季其他買入標的，同期下跌 13% to 26%。

news.title: Alphabet's Cloud Business Doubled, but the Stock Plunged. Here's What a $5,000 Investment Could Be Worth by 2030.
news.summary: Alphabet is spending big to build out its cloud computing platform.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 雲端業務翻倍，股價卻暴跌。$5,000 投資到 2030 可能值多少。
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 斥資龐大建設其雲端運算平台。

news.title: Scott Galloway: If AI Is “Like the Railroads,” Alphabet and Microsoft “Would Still Be Fine”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway said on Prof G Markets that Alphabet and Microsoft would “still be fine” even if AI proves as overhyped as the railroads, while neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius are “levered trades to AI. ”Advertising brought in $294.
news.title_zh: Scott Galloway：若 AI「如鐵路業」，Alphabet 和 Microsoft「仍會好好的」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Scott Galloway 在 Prof G Markets 表示，即使 AI 證明像鐵路業那樣被過度炒作，Alphabet 和 Microsoft 「仍會好好的」，而 CoreWeave 和 Nebius 等新雲端廠商則是「槓桿押注 AI」。廣告帶來 $294。

news.title: Apple Vs. Alphabet: Who’s The Better Flight-to-Quality Anchor Now?
news.summary: Two mega-cap earnings reports landed within days of each other, and one company is quietly paying for its ambitions while the other is borrowing and issuing shares to fund them. Which balance sheet deserves your defensive dollars?
news.title_zh: Apple 對決 Alphabet：誰是現在更好的避險優質錨定股？
news.summary_zh: 兩份超大型股財報相隔幾天出爐，一家公司悄悄自掏腰包支付其野心，另一家則靠借錢和發行股票來籌資。哪張資產負債表配得上你的防禦性資金？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBank of America kept its Buy rating and $178 price target on Alibaba on Nov. 11.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴表現失望一年：為何美國銀行看好 76% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要美國銀行維持阿里巴巴買進評級及 $178 目標價，於 Nov. 11。

news.title: Trump’s Commerce Dept. Halted a Chip Probe “After Nvidia Intervention.” That’s Nvidia’s Bigger Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysThe New York Times reported that a Commerce Department probe into Megaspeed was halted after NVIDIA’s top lawyer named a Trump-nominated official. Megaspeed imported billions of dollars of NVIDIA equipment into Malaysia for data centers serving Chinese clients, including Alibaba.
news.title_zh: 川普商務部叫停晶片調查「在輝達介入後」。這是輝達更大的問題
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點《紐約時報》報導，商務部對Megaspeed的調查在輝達首席律師點名一位川普提名官員後被叫停。Megaspeed進口數十億美元的輝達設備到馬來西亞，為服務中國客戶（包括阿里巴巴）的資料中心提供服務。

news.title: Alibaba Just Gained 12% in a Week as the Nasdaq Fell: Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba stock rose 12% in the past week after Apple picked Qwen for its China AI launch. Money also rotated out of US AI hardware into cheap Chinese internet stocks like Alibaba and Tencent.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴在一週內上漲 12%，而納斯達克下跌：獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴股價在過去一週上漲 12%，因蘋果選擇 Qwen 為其中國 AI 發布。資金也從美國 AI 硬體輪動撤出，流入阿里巴巴和騰訊等便宜的中國網路股。

news.title: Nvidia’s Chinese Clients Will Get Just 1% of $70 Billion in RTX Chip Orders
news.summary: Key TakeawaysChinese AI and cloud firms, Alibaba among them, have ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips worth about $70 billion, but expect to get only about 1% of them over the next four months. With too little capacity to go around, NVIDIA is building its most advanced, higher-margin chips first, so China’s orders are left waiting.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 的中國客戶在 RTX 晶片訂單中將僅獲得 1% 之 $70 Billion
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要中國 AI 與雲端企業（包括阿里巴巴）已訂購約 6 million 顆 NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 晶片，價值約 $70 billion，但預期未來四個月僅能獲得其中約 1%。因產能不足，NVIDIA 優先生產最先進、利潤較高的晶片，導致中國訂單被迫等待。

news.title: PDD Holdings Rises 3.9%, Alibaba Up 3.5% as China Signals Fresh Stock Market Support
news.summary: Key TakeawaysPDD Holdings rose 3. 9% on Monday, Nov.
news.title_zh: PDD Holdings 上漲 3.9%，阿里巴巴上漲 3.5%，因中國釋出新股市支援訊號
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 PDD Holdings 上漲 3。 9% 於週一，十一月。

news.title: Amazon vs. Alibaba: Two E-Commerce Giants, a Big Valuation Gap, but Which Offers More Upside in 2027?
news.summary: Amazon and Alibaba are investing heavily in the future of e-commerce and artificial intelligence, but a substantial valuation gap could make one the more attractive opportunity heading into 2027.
news.title_zh: Amazon vs. Alibaba：兩大電商巨頭，估值差距巨大，但哪一檔在 2027 更具上漲潛力？
news.summary_zh: Amazon 和 Alibaba 正大力投資電商與人工智慧的未來，但龐大的估值落差可能使其中一檔成為進入 2027 時更具吸引力的機會。

news.title: Alibaba vs. Target: Comparing Revenue Trends Between Two Retail Titans
news.summary: Alibaba consistently outpaces Target by billions each quarter, but both reveal identical seasonal patterns that could reshape how investors value growth.
news.title_zh: Alibaba vs. Target：比較兩大零售巨頭的營收趨勢
news.summary_zh: Alibaba 每季持續以數十億美元超越 Target，但兩者呈現相同的季節性模式，可能重塑投資人對成長的估值方式。

news.title: Alibaba Soars 6% as Apple Sets December Launch for Qwen-Powered iPhone AI in China
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba shares jumped 6% after Apple picked Qwen for its December AI launch in China, while JD. com and PDD Holdings rose on Chinese market support.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴飆升 6%，蘋果訂於十二月在中國推出搭載 Qwen 的 iPhone AI
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴股價跳升 6%，因蘋果選擇 Qwen 作為其十二月在中國的 AI 推出，而京東和拼多多控股因中國市場支持而上漲。

news.title: Apple Made $64.85 Billion in China in 9 Months Without AI. Now Alibaba’s Qwen Is Coming to Siri
news.summary: Key TakeawaysApple will launch its first Apple Intelligence features in mainland China with iOS 27. 3 in December, with Alibaba’s Qwen inside Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence and Baidu also building features for Chinese users.
news.title_zh: 蘋果在中國 $64.85 Billion，在 9 個月內未使用 AI。現在阿里巴巴的 Qwen 即將進駐 Siri
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Apple 將在中國大陸推出其首個 Apple Intelligence 功能，搭配 iOS 27。3 在十二月，阿里巴巴的 Qwen 將內建於 Siri、寫作工具和視覺智能中，百度也在為中國用戶建構功能。

news.title_zh: Michael Burry 一年前警告此 AI 風險。Microsoft 可能剛證明了他的觀點
news.summary_zh: Microsoft 剛退出一項 Oracle GPU 交易，而 Oracle 堅稱需求強勁。一份失效的合約可能掌握 Michael Burry 折舊警告所缺乏的定價證據，下一份財報可能會揭曉誰是對的。

news.title: Microsoft Is Fighting a Ban on Chinese Parts Inside AI Data Centers
news.summary: Microsoft took its fight against a proposed FCC transceiver ban straight to the White House, yet the stock barely flinched while optical suppliers surged. The real story hinges on a speed threshold and a date years away.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 正在對抗 AI 資料中心內中國零件的禁令
news.summary_zh: Microsoft 將其對抗擬議的 FCC 收發器禁令的鬥爭直接帶到白宮，但股價幾乎未動，光學供應商卻大漲。真正的故事取決於一個速度門檻和幾年後的日期。

news.title: If This Tech Giant Doubles, Here’s What $10,000 Could Become
news.summary: Azure is booming and a $677 billion backlog is waiting to convert, yet only one forecast path pushes Microsoft past the doubling line. Find out which scenario gets there, when it happens, and what could derail it.
news.title_zh: 若這家科技巨頭股價翻倍，$10,000 可能成為什麼樣子
news.summary_zh: Azure 榮景正盛，$677 billion 積壓訂單待轉化，但僅有一條預測路徑能推動微軟突破翻倍門檻。找出哪種情境能達成、何時發生，以及什麼可能使其脫軌。

news.title: Nvidia Is Back Below $4 Trillion, and Microsoft Just Passed It
news.summary: A late-night report about boardroom turmoil sent Nvidia tumbling after the bell, and the race for the No. 2 spot now hangs on a gap thinner than a couple of dollars per share. Thursday's open could settle it.
news.title_zh: 輝跌回 $4 Trillion 下方，微軟剛超越它
news.summary_zh: 深夜關於董事會動盪的報導導致輝達盤後重挫，第 2 大寶座之爭如今僅差幾美元每股的微小差距。週四開盤可能定勝負。

news.title: Scott Galloway: If AI Is “Like the Railroads,” Alphabet and Microsoft “Would Still Be Fine”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway said on Prof G Markets that Alphabet and Microsoft would “still be fine” even if AI proves as overhyped as the railroads, while neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius are “levered trades to AI. ”Advertising brought in $294.
news.title_zh: Scott Galloway：若 AI「如鐵路業」，Alphabet 和 Microsoft「仍會好好的」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Scott Galloway 在 Prof G Markets 表示，即使 AI 證明像鐵路業那樣被過度炒作，Alphabet 和 Microsoft 「仍會好好的」，而 CoreWeave 和 Nebius 等新雲端廠商則是「槓桿押注 AI」。廣告帶來 $294。

news.title: Wall Street Models Lag Structural Reality, Prompting Me To Add an ‘Overvalued’ Apple
news.summary: Apple trades above every analyst target on the Street, yet one investor keeps buying after each earnings report. Why he passes on cheaper-looking Microsoft and Alphabet, and what memory costs could do to the thesis, makes for a contrarian case.
news.title_zh: 華爾街模型落後於結構性現實，促使我增持「高估」的蘋果
news.summary_zh: 蘋果股價高於華爾街所有分析師目標價，但一位投資人在每次財報後持續買入。為何他放棄看似更便宜的微軟和Alphabet，以及記憶體成本可能對投資論點造成的影響，構成了一個反向投資案例。

news.title: Apple's Market Cap Grew From $347 Billion to $4.6 Trillion During Tim Cook's 15 Years as CEO. Here's What That Growth Curve Means for Apple's Next Chapter Under John Ternus.
news.summary: John Ternus inherited a financial machine and is already spending on foldables, AI, and possibly servers.
news.title_zh: Apple 市值在 Tim Cook 擔任執行長的 15 年間從 $347 Billion to $4.6 Trillion 成長。這條成長曲線對 John Ternus 領導下的 Apple 下一階段意味著什麼。
news.summary_zh: John Ternus 繼承了一台財務機器，並已在可折疊裝置、AI 和可能的伺服器上投入資金。

news.title: The AI Chip Race with Apple’s Former Chief Chip Architect
news.summary: Former Apple chip architect Gerard Williams III discusses his time at the company, including the development of Apple’s A7 through M1 processors, and his latest effort to build powerful, energy-efficient CPUs for the AI data center boom with his new company NUVACORE. Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: 與 Apple 前首席晶片架構師談 AI 晶片競賽
news.summary_zh: 前 Apple 晶片架構師 Gerard Williams III 談論他在公司的時光，包括 Apple A7 至 M1 處理器的開發，以及他與新公司 NUVACORE 為 AI 資料中心熱潮打造強大、節能 CPU 的最新努力。有問題要問 Mark 嗎？請電郵至 poweron@bloomberg.net 或加入 Power On Discord 訂閱 Power On Newsletter：https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron（來源：Bloomberg）

news.title: What to Watch When Berkshire Hathaway Files Its 13F on Monday
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway’s 13F for the quarter ended Sept. 30 is due Monday, and its last one showed Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola, Alphabet and Bank of America as its five biggest positions.
news.title_zh: 伯克希爾·哈撒韋週一提交 13F 時應關注什麼
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：伯克希爾·哈撒韋截至 Sept. 30 季度的 13F 將於週一公布，其上一份報告顯示蘋果、美國運通、可口可樂、Alphabet 和美國銀行為其前五大持倉。

news.title: Trump to Nvidia: Hire Tim Cook so “a Legend Replaces a Legend.” Bad Idea.
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA shares fell 5% after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, and President Trump posted that Apple’s Tim Cook should take his place. Cook is the best operator in tech, but NVIDIA needs a technical leader who can set its chip and software roadmap.
news.title_zh: Trump 致 Nvidia：聘用 Tim Cook 讓「傳奇接替傳奇」。壞主意。
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點NVIDIA 股價在 Jensen Huang 辭去執行長後下跌 5%，總統 Trump 發文稱 Apple 的 Tim Cook 應接替其位。Cook 是科技界最佳營運者，但 NVIDIA 需要一位能制定晶片與軟體路線圖的技術領導者。

news.title: Trump says Apple's Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
news.summary: President Trump called for Tim Cook, chairman of Apple, to be the new president and CEO of Nvidia after Jensen Huang's resignation.
news.title_zh: Trump 稱 Apple 的 Tim Cook 應取代 Jensen Huang 擔任 Nvidia 執行長
news.summary_zh: 總統 Trump 呼籲 Apple 主席 Tim Cook 在 Jensen Huang 辭職後出任 Nvidia 新任總裁兼執行長。

news.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
news.summary: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.
news.title_zh: 川普提名蘋果董事長 Tim Cook 為 Jensen Huang 繼任者
news.summary_zh: 川普總統在 Truth Social 貼文中表示，只有一個人能取代 Jensen Huang 掌管 Nvidia：Tim Cook。

news.title: Apple’s Growth Now Rides on Price Hikes. The Problem: “There’s a Wall” per Alex Kantrowitz
news.summary: Key TakeawaysUBS expects Apple’s iPhone revenue to rise 12% to $95 billion this holiday quarter even as unit sales fall 3%, so higher prices are carrying the growth. Apple’s price increases haven’t stopped its gross margin from falling, so it may need more of them just to hold its margin.
news.title_zh: 蘋果成長現仰賴漲價。問題在於：「撞牆了」——Alex Kantrowitz 指出
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要UBS 預期蘋果 iPhone 營收將在假日季上升 12% 至 $95 billion，即使銷量下滑 3%，因此較高價格支撐了成長。蘋果的漲價未能阻止毛利率下滑，故可能需要更多漲價才能維持毛利。

news.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Resigns As CEO With CFO Colette Kress To Step In: Analyst Compares To Apple’s ‘Steve Jobs Moment’
news.summary: Nvidia said Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO, and a board member, effective immediately.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 的 Jensen Huang 辭去 CEO，CFO Colette Kress 接任：分析師比擬蘋果的「Steve Jobs 時刻」
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 表示 Jensen Huang 已辭去總裁、CEO 及董事會成員職務，即時生效。

news.title: Apple HomeView Review: It's a Latecomer, But the Ecosystem Integration is a Plus
news.summary: Nothing about this smart display is groundbreaking, but it works well and should feel instantly familiar to Apple fans.
news.title_zh: Apple HomeView 評測：雖然遲到，但生態系統整合是優勢
news.summary_zh: 這款智慧顯示器沒有任何突破性創新，但運作良好，應讓果粉瞬間感到熟悉。

news.title: Tim Cook, Former Apple CEO, Should Run Nvidia
news.summary: Nvidia's board is probing its CEO, a Singapore revenue stream has vanished from the books, and no internal successor can reassure Wall Street. Only one tech veteran might have the stature to steady the AI giant, and he just left a very big job.
news.title_zh: 前 Apple CEO Tim Cook 應該經營 Nvidia
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 董事會正在調查其 CEO，一條新加坡營收來源從帳面上消失，且無內部繼任者能讓華爾街安心。只有一位科技資深人士可能具備穩定 AI 巨頭的地位，而他剛離開一份非常重要的工作。

news.title: Apple Is Hovering Around an All-Time High Despite the Broader Tech Sell-Off. Will New Products Like the iPhone Duo and HomeView Give Apple Even More Room to Run?
news.summary: The innovation pipeline is robust under new CEO John Ternus.
news.title_zh: 儘管科技股大賣，Apple 股價仍徘徊在歷史高點附近。iPhone Duo 和 HomeView 等新產品能讓 Apple 更有上漲空間嗎？
news.summary_zh: 在新任 CEO John Ternus 領導下，創新管線強勁。

news.title: Airbnb (ABNB) And The AI Travel Deal That Could Rewire Trip Booking
news.summary: Airbnb (NasdaqGS:ABNB) faces a new competitive risk after OpenAI acquired Odessia, an AI travel planning platform, in 2026. Odessia’s system is designed to handle end to end trip planning, from discovery to booking, through AI powered recommendations. OpenAI’s move positions AI driven trip planning as a potential front door for travelers, which could redirect traffic away from Airbnb’s existing booking funnel. OpenAI’s purchase of Odessia could reshape how guests find stays, but Airbnb’s...

news.summary_zh: Rumble 虧損擴大本應嚇退交易者，但創紀錄的空單與新 AI 雲端業務改變了氣氛。了解 Quake AI、CoreWeave 和加密貨幣驅動的競爭對手揭示了真金白銀流向何方。

Marvell has enjoyed a nice surge since the acquisition - one of the largest in tech history - and the company has a history of needing to reshape its brand and business which could be helpful. news.title: Credo and Lumentum Sink 14% in a Week as Democrats’ Sweep Hits AI Data Centers
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCredo Technology stock fell 14% in the past week after Democrats’ midterm sweep hit AI data center stocks, and Lumentum and Marvell fell with it. Credo had no bad news of its own, and its guidance for the current quarter still stands.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Credo Technology 股價在過去一週下跌 14%，原因是民主黨在期中選舉大勝衝擊了 AI 資料中心股票，Lumentum 和 Marvell 也隨之下跌。Credo 本身沒有壞消息，其本季財測依然有效。

news.title: Lumentum Sinks 11% in a Week as Marvell’s All-Stock Offer Shrinks: “Our Demand Couldn’t Be Stronger”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 11% in the past week as the AI hardware selloff hit Marvell, whose all-stock offer drives its price, and it lagged Coherent’s rebound. September-quarter revenue rose 136.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 一週下跌 11%，因 Marvell 全股票收購要約縮水：「我們的需求再強烈也不過分」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Lumentum 過去一週下跌 11%，AI 硬體拋售潮衝擊 Marvell，其全股票收購要約決定 Lumentum 股價，且 Lumentum 落後於 Coherent 的反彈。九月季營收上升 136。

news.title: “The Next Trillion Dollar Company”: Marvell Is Up 82% in 2026. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell is up 82% in 2026, even after losing about half its value since its June high. NVIDIA’s $2 billion investment, Jensen Huang’s trillion-dollar call and 46% data center growth last quarter drove the run.
news.title_zh: 「下一家兆元公司」：Marvell 上漲 82% 在 2026。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Marvell 上漲 82% 在 2026，即使自六月高點以來已跌去約一半價值。輝達的 $2 billion 投資、黃仁勳的兆元呼聲以及 46% 資料中心上季成長推高了股價。

news.title: Even After a Cut, B. Riley’s $250 Target Says Marvell’s Selloff Went Too Far
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology is down 51% from its June high, and most of the drop since Oct. 28 tracks its all-stock deal for Lumentum and the Democratic sweep in Congress.
news.title_zh: 即使下調後，B. Riley 的 $250 目標價顯示 Marvell 跌太深
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Marvell Technology 從六月高點下跌 51%，且自 Oct. 28 以來的大部分跌幅反映了其收購 Lumentum 的全股票交易以及民主黨在國會橫掃獲勝。

news.title: Why Marvell Technology Stock Fell Hard in October
news.summary: Investors continued to exit AI positions, and news of a new Marvell acquisition sent shares falling.

news.summary_zh: 投資人持續撤離 AI 部位，加上 Marvell 新收購案消息傳出，導致股價下跌。

news.title: Fabrinet Dropped 33% in a Month Despite a Record Quarter. Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysFabrinet shares fell 33% in the past month as AI optics stocks sold off on fears about AI funding, and Lumentum, Marvell and Coherent fell even further. Fabrinet’s fiscal first-quarter revenue rose 51% to a record $1.

news.title: The Smart Money AI Trade Could Look Very Different in 2027
news.summary: Micron's revenue more than tripled, yet a violent chipmaker selloff just erased a quarter of its value in a week. Wall Street still sees the stock doubling, and the math behind that bet rests on a surprisingly low multiple.
news.title_zh: 聰明資金的 AI 交易在 2027 可能會大不相同
news.summary_zh: 美光營收成長超過三倍，但劇烈的晶片製造商拋售潮在一週內抹去了其四分之一的價值。華爾街仍看好股價翻倍，而該押注背後的數學依據建立在一個驚人低的倍數上。

news.title: Sandisk, Micron, and SK Hynix Slide 3% as NVIDIA Shake-Up Hits Memory Stocks
news.summary: When the AI industry's biggest name loses its chief executive, the chips that feed it feel the tremor first. Memory makers are sliding while tech climbs, and one of them has a surprisingly low multiple that cuts both ways.
news.title_zh: 隨著 NVIDIA 震盪波及記憶體股，Sandisk、美光和 SK Hynix 下滑 3%
news.summary_zh: 當 AI 產業最大的名字失去其執行長時，供應其晶片的廠商最先感受到震動。記憶體製造商下滑而科技股上漲，其中一家擁有驚人低的倍數，這把雙面刃切兩邊。

news.title: Micron Is Back Above $800 After Its Best Day Since July
news.summary: A memory maker briefly outranked the biggest US bank, but only until the closing bell. One week after a brutal selloff, Micron's rebound faces a test that has nothing to do with a single strong day.
news.title_zh: 美光重返 $800 上方，創下自七月以來最佳單日表現
news.summary_zh: 一家記憶體製造商一度超越美國最大銀行，但僅持續到收盤鐘響。在經歷慘烈拋售一週後，美光的反彈面臨考驗，這與單一強勢交易日無關。

news.title: Join The Dip Buyers in Micron If You Dare
news.summary: Micron trades at a fraction of its earnings power with its output nearly sold out, yet every blowout report lately has triggered a brutal selloff. Two upcoming tests will reveal whether this dip is a gift or a trap.
news.title_zh: 如果你敢,加入 Micron 的抄底買家行列
news.summary_zh: Micron 的股價僅為其盈利能力的一小部分,產能幾乎售罄,但最近每份超預期財報都引發了慘烈拋售。即將到來的兩項測試將揭示這次下跌是禮物還是陷阱。

news.summary_zh: 隨著對 AI 基礎設施的熱情回歸,華爾街週三強勢反彈,帶動半導體和科技股上漲,儘管通脹擔憂持續存在。

news.title: Micron Stock Is Down 40% From Its Peak After the Sell-Off. History Says This Is What Happens Next.

news.summary_zh: 在記憶體市場有利條件下,Micron 可能再次展開精彩的牛市行情。

news.title: How Much Tax Does a 66-Year-Old Owe Selling $600,000 in Micron and Oracle Gains?
news.summary: A retired couple sitting on $600,000 of Micron and Oracle gains can take it all now or stretch it out. One path cuts the tax bill but triggers a surprise Medicare cost, and plunging share prices complicate the choice.
news.title_zh: 一位 66 歲老人出售 $600,000 的 Micron 和 Oracle 獲利需繳多少稅?
news.summary_zh: 一對退休夫婦持有 $600,000 的 Micron 和 Oracle 獲利,可以選擇一次變現或分批出售。一條路徑能減少稅單但會觸發意外的醫療保險費用,而股價暴跌讓選擇更加複雜。

news.title: Jim Cramer Says Micron Isn’t Going Away. Here’s Why He Picks It Over Sandisk
news.summary: Memory stocks just ripped higher, yet both names remain deep in the red for the month. Cramer sees one clear winner in the group, but the bull case for its rival is stronger than his pick suggests.
news.title_zh: Jim Cramer 說 Micron 不會消失。這是他選擇它而非 Sandisk 的原因
news.summary_zh: 記憶體股票剛大幅上漲，但兩檔股票本月仍深陷跌勢。Cramer 看好群組中有一明確贏家，但其競爭對手的多頭理由比他的選擇所暗示的更強。

news.title: Marvell Acquires Lumentum in Blockbuster $80 Billion Deal
news.summary: There has been no shortage of news these last few weeks coming out of the memory and optics sectors in regards to AI investing. Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith are here to break down just a few of them, including Marvell's purchase of Lumentum in a huge $80 billion deal. Marvell has enjoyed a nice surge since the acquisition - one of the largest in tech history - and the company has a history of needing to reshape its brand and business which could be helpful. The two also shared some updates in regards to companies including Micron, Semtech and Alphabet, as well as what investors can expect from them as we move into 2027.
news.title_zh: Marvell 以超級 $80 Billion 交易收購 Lumentum
news.summary_zh: 過去幾週來自記憶體和光學產業關於 AI 投資的消息不絕於耳。Eric Bleeker 和 Austin Smith 在這裡為您分析其中幾項，包括 Marvell 以巨額 $80 billion 交易收購 Lumentum。自收購以來，Marvell 享受了不錯的漲勢——這是科技史上最大筆交易之一——且該公司有重塑品牌和業務的歷史，這可能會有所幫助。兩人還分享了關於 Micron、Semtech 和 Alphabet 等公司的最新動態，以及隨著我們進入 2027，投資人可以從他們身上期待什麼。

news.title: Qualcomm's AI data centre ambitions offer upside, but Bank of America remains cautious
news.summary: Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM, XETRA:QCI), is positioning itself as a full-stack supplier to AI data centres, with ambitions to capture up to $50 billion of a rapidly expanding market. Bank of America (BoA) maintained its 'underperform' rating despite growing confidence in Qualcomm's emerging...

news.title: Sandisk Sinks 24% in a Week on “Industry-Wide Memory Dynamics”: Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSandisk fell 24% in a week after the midterms and a Qualcomm warning on memory costs, and Micron and SK hynix fell too. Sandisk’s own quarter held up, but its flash price gains are slowing.

news.summary_zh: 高通非手機業務的成長可能在 2026 表現不佳後大幅提振股價表現。

news.title: Apple Just Hit $5 Trillion. Its “Biggest Competition” Is a SpaceX Phone, Says Gene Munster
news.summary: Key TakeawaysApple closed above $350 for the first time on Monday, which took its market value back above $5 trillion. Gene Munster says Apple’s biggest competition is a SpaceX phone that Elon Musk has called “utterly false,” and SpaceX is already building a nationwide 5G network with Qualcomm.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Apple 週一收盤首次站上 $350，使其市值重回 $5 trillion 以上。Gene Munster 表示 Apple 最大的競爭對手是 SpaceX 手機，Elon Musk 稱此說法「完全錯誤」，而 SpaceX 已與高通合作建設全美 5G 網路。

news.title: I Bonds Pay 5.51%. Why Retirees Might Still Prefer Dividend Stocks
news.summary: A Treasury-backed bond out-yields Coca-Cola and Qualcomm by a wide margin, yet retirees keep buying dividend stocks. Between lockups, state taxes, and a missing paycheck, the real math may surprise you.

news.summary_zh: Qualcomm 的手機業務快速萎縮，然而一個較安靜的部門剛公布創紀錄季度，鮮少投資人關注。它能否擺脫盈餘損害，我們的模型預測股價將落在何處？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNebius stock fell 12% in a week as the midterms and a Microsoft report hit the neoclouds, IREN and CoreWeave included. Microsoft’s tighter oversight of Nebius’s projects is a bigger risk than the election, though Nebius carried a sliver of CoreWeave’s debt at midyear.

news.title_zh: 「當我當選州長時這就會停止」：Cipher Digital 和 CleanSpark 一週內下跌近 20%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Cipher Digital 在一週內下跌 20% 至 Nov. 10，連同 CleanSpark 和 IREN，在德州選出一位想要暫停新資料中心的州長後。

news.title: CRWV Stock Climbs 8% After-Hours As $132B Revenue Backlog Reinforces AI Compute Demand: NBIS, IREN Tick Higher
news.summary: The company’s revenue backlog stood at approximately $132.5 billion as of the end of the quarter, up from approximately $104.2 billion as of June 30.
news.title_zh: CRWV 股價盤後上漲 8%，因 $132B 營收積壓強化 AI 運算需求：NBIS、IREN 小幅上揚
news.summary_zh: 該公司的營收積壓截至季底約為 $132.5 billion，較截至 June 30 的約 $104.2 billion 有所增加。

news.title: IREN Sinks 10% as Analyst Target Cuts Pile Up After Microsoft Delay; Cipher Digital Falls 6%, TeraWulf Slides 2%
news.summary: A delayed Microsoft buildout and a $6 billion funding hole have analysts slashing IREN targets, and a hot inflation print is making it worse. Why are two rival miners holding up better, and what separates their models?
news.title_zh: IREN暴跌 10%，因微軟延遲導致分析師目標價下調累積；Cipher Digital下跌 6%，TeraWulf下滑 2%
news.summary_zh: 微軟建設延遲和 $6 billion 資金缺口導致分析師大幅下調IREN目標價，熱門通脹數據讓情況更糟。為何兩家競爭對手礦商表現較好，其模式有何不同？

news.title: JPMorgan Cut Its IREN Target to $55. It Still Sees 148% Upside
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan cut its IREN price target to $55 from $65 on Monday and kept its Overweight rating, leaving 148% upside after a 68% drop in a year. IREN pushed its $4 billion revenue run-rate target into early 2027 after Microsoft asked for a network upgrade, and $6 billion of this fiscal year’s build still needs funding.
news.title_zh: JPMorgan 將 IREN 目標價下調至 $55。仍看好 148% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要JPMorgan 週一將 IREN 目標價從 $65 下調至 $55，維持增持評級，在一年下跌 68% 後仍留有 148% 上漲空間。IREN 在微軟要求網路升級後，將其 $4 billion 營收運行率目標推遲至 2027 初，且本財年建設的 $6 billion 仍需資金。

news.title: Microsoft Dumps Oracle. Good News: Those Old Chips Renew at a “20% Premium”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle because its older Nvidia chips no longer fit Microsoft’s specifications, Bloomberg reported. Oracle says GPUs renewed last quarter, mostly four years or older, went at a 20% premium, and IREN just recontracted older H100s at double the price.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 棄用 Oracle。好消息：舊晶片續約享有「20% 溢價」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：彭博社報導，Microsoft 正逐步終止一項向 Oracle 租用 AI 運算的 2023 協議，因其較舊的 Nvidia 晶片不再符合 Microsoft 規範。Oracle 表示，上季續約的 GPU 大多為四年或以上機齡，享有 20% 溢價，而 IREN 剛以雙倍價格重新簽約較舊的 H100s。

news.title: IREN Limited: A Long AI Winter Is Coming (Rating Downgrade)
news.summary: IREN Limited's AI cloud backlog and revenue growth are overshadowed by negative free cash flow. Check out why IREN stock is downgraded to a hold.
news.title_zh: IREN Limited：漫長的 AI 寒冬即將來臨（評級下調）
news.summary_zh: IREN Limited 的 AI 雲端積壓訂單與營收增長被負自由現金流所掩蓋。了解為何 IREN 股票被下調為持有評級。

news.title: Could IREN Actually Climb 117%? Or Is Cantor Fitzgerald Totally Wrong?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN stock is down 72% from its peak a year ago, and Cantor Fitzgerald cut its price target to $47 from $99 on Nov. 6 while keeping an Overweight rating.
news.title_zh: IREN 真的能漲至 117% 嗎？還是 Cantor Fitzgerald 完全錯了？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要IREN 股價較一年前高點下跌 72%，Cantor Fitzgerald 將目標價從 $99 下調至 $47，於 Nov. 6 維持增持評級。

news.title: IREN Falls 5% After Friday’s 20% Surge as AI Lending Worries Mount; TeraWulf and Applied Digital Rise 2%
news.summary: Banks are tightening the purse strings on AI data center debt, and not every former crypto miner is feeling the squeeze equally. One company owns its GPUs and carries billions in unfunded plans, while its peers lean on a different playbook.
news.title_zh: IREN 下跌 5%，此前週五飆漲 20%，AI 放貸憂慮升溫；TeraWulf 和 Applied Digital 上漲 2%
news.summary_zh: 銀行收緊 AI 資料中心債務融資，並非每家前加密貨幣礦商都同樣感受到擠壓。一家公司擁有自己的 GPU 並背負數十億美元未撥資金計畫，而其同業則採取不同策略。
